| extensions     | grant_pg_cron_access               | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_cron_access()<br> RETURNS event_trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SET search_path TO ''<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>  IF EXISTS (<br>    SELECT<br>    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev<br>    JOIN pg_extension AS ext<br>    ON ev.objid = ext.oid<br>    WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_cron'<br>  )<br>  THEN<br>    grant usage on schema cron to postgres with grant option;<br><br>    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on tables to postgres with grant option;<br>    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on functions to postgres with grant option;<br>    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on sequences to postgres with grant option;<br><br>    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all<br>        on sequences to postgres with grant option;<br>    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all<br>        on tables to postgres with grant option;<br>    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all<br>        on functions to postgres with grant option;<br><br>    grant all privileges on all tables in schema cron to postgres with grant option;<br>    revoke all on table cron.job from postgres;<br>    grant select on table cron.job to postgres with grant option;<br>    revoke trigger on cron.job_run_details from postgres;<br>  END IF;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | extensions     | grant_pg_graphql_access            | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_graphql_access()<br> RETURNS event_trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SET search_path TO ''<br>AS $function$<br>begin<br>    if not exists (<br>        select 1<br>        from pg_catalog.pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() ev<br>        join pg_catalog.pg_extension e on ev.objid = e.oid<br>        where e.extname = 'pg_graphql'<br>    ) then<br>        return;<br>    end if;<br><br>    drop function if exists graphql_public.graphql;<br>    create or replace function graphql_public.graphql(<br>        "operationName" text default null,<br>        query text default null,<br>        variables jsonb default null,<br>        extensions jsonb default null<br>    )<br>        returns jsonb<br>        language sql<br>    as $$<br>        select graphql.resolve(<br>            query := query,<br>            variables := coalesce(variables, '{}'),<br>            "operationName" := "operationName",<br>            extensions := extensions<br>        );<br>    $$;<br><br>    -- Attach the wrapper to the extension so DROP EXTENSION cascades to it,<br>    -- which in turn triggers set_graphql_placeholder to reinstall the "not enabled" stub.<br>    alter extension pg_graphql add function graphql_public.graphql(text, text, jsonb, jsonb);<br><br>    grant usage on schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;<br>    grant execute on function graphql.resolve to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;<br>    grant usage on schema graphql to postgres with grant option;<br>    grant usage on schema graphql_public to postgres with grant option;<br>end;<br>$function$<br> | extensions     | grant_pg_net_access                | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_net_access()<br> RETURNS event_trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SET search_path TO ''<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>  IF EXISTS (<br>    SELECT 1<br>    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev<br>    JOIN pg_extension AS ext<br>    ON ev.objid = ext.oid<br>    WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_net'<br>  )<br>  THEN<br>    IF NOT EXISTS (<br>      SELECT 1<br>      FROM pg_roles<br>      WHERE rolname = 'supabase_functions_admin'<br>    )<br>    THEN<br>      CREATE USER supabase_functions_admin NOINHERIT CREATEROLE LOGIN NOREPLICATION;<br>    END IF;<br><br>    GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA net TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;<br><br>    IF EXISTS (<br>      SELECT FROM pg_extension<br>      WHERE extname = 'pg_net'<br>      -- all versions in use on existing projects as of 2025-02-20<br>      -- version 0.12.0 onwards don't need these applied<br>      AND extversion IN ('0.2', '0.6', '0.7', '0.7.1', '0.8.0', '0.10.0', '0.11.0')<br>    ) THEN<br>      ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER;<br>      ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER;<br><br>      ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net;<br>      ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net;<br><br>      REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC;<br>      REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC;<br><br>      GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;<br>      GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;<br>    END IF;<br>  END IF;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | extensions     | pgrst_ddl_watch                    | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch()<br> RETURNS event_trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SET search_path TO ''<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>  cmd record;<br>BEGIN<br>  FOR cmd IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()<br>  LOOP<br>    IF cmd.command_tag IN (<br>      'CREATE SCHEMA', 'ALTER SCHEMA'<br>    , 'CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO', 'ALTER TABLE'<br>    , 'CREATE FOREIGN TABLE', 'ALTER FOREIGN TABLE'<br>    , 'CREATE VIEW', 'ALTER VIEW'<br>    , 'CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW', 'ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW'<br>    , 'CREATE FUNCTION', 'ALTER FUNCTION'<br>    , 'CREATE TRIGGER'<br>    , 'CREATE TYPE', 'ALTER TYPE'<br>    , 'CREATE RULE'<br>    , 'COMMENT'<br>    )<br>    -- don't notify in case of CREATE TEMP table or other objects created on pg_temp<br>    AND cmd.schema_name is distinct from 'pg_temp'<br>    THEN<br>      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';<br>    END IF;<br>  END LOOP;<br>END; $function$<br> $function$<br>DECLARE<br>  obj record;<br>BEGIN<br>  FOR obj IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects()<br>  LOOP<br>    IF obj.object_type IN (<br>      'schema'<br>    , 'table'<br>    , objects<br>    THEN<br>      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';<br>    END IF;<br>  END LOOP;<br>END; $function$<br> | extensions     | set_graphql_placeholder            | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.set_graphql_placeholder()<br> RETURNS event_trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SET search_path TO ''<br>AS $function$<br>    DECLARE<br>    graphql_is_dropped bool;<br>    BEGIN<br>    graphql_is_dropped = (<br>        SELECT ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public'<br>        FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects() AS ev<br>        WHERE ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public'<br>    );<br><br>    IF graphql_is_dropped<br>    THEN<br>        create or replace function graphql_public.graphql(<br>            "operationName" text default null,<br>            query text default null,<br>            variables jsonb default null,<br>            extensions jsonb default null<br>        )<br>            returns jsonb<br>            language plpgsql<br>            set search_path to ''<br>        as $$<br>            DECLARE<br>                server_version float;<br>            BEGIN<br>                server_version = (SELECT (SPLIT_PART((select version()), ' ', 2))::float);<br><br>                IF server_version >= 14 THEN<br>                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(<br>                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(<br>                            jsonb_build_object(<br>                                'message', 'pg_graphql extension is not enabled.'<br>                            )<br>                        )<br>                    );<br>                ELSE<br>                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(<br>                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(<br>                            jsonb_build_object(<br>                                'message', 'pg_graphql is only available on projects running Postgres 14 onwards.'<br>                            )<br>                        )<br>                    );<br>                END IF;<br>            END;<br>        $$;<br>    END IF;<br><br>    END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | check_contact_optout               | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_contact_optout()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF upper(trim(NEW.message)) IN ('SAIR', 'PARAR', 'STOP', 'CANCELAR') THEN<br>        UPDATE public.contacts<br>        SET opted_out = true, opted_out_at = now()<br>        WHERE phone = NEW.phone;<br>    END IF;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | check_device_limit_before_insert   | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_device_limit_before_insert()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    v_max_devices INT;<br>    v_current_count INT;<br>BEGIN<br>    SELECT COALESCE(t.max_devices, 1) INTO v_max_devices<br>    FROM public.tenants t<br>    WHERE t.id = (<br>        -- Pega o tenant do usuário ou o primeiro tenant ativo<br>        SELECT COALESCE(tenant_id, (SELECT id FROM public.tenants WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1))<br>        FROM public.api_tokens<br>        WHERE ativo = true<br>        LIMIT 1<br>    );<br><br>    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_current_count<br>    FROM public.devices<br>    WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;<br><br>    IF v_current_count >= v_max_devices THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Limite de dispositivos atingido para o seu plano atual (% aparelho(s)). Faça upgrade para conectar mais nós.', v_max_devices;<br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | enqueue_sms_inbound_webhook        | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_sms_inbound_webhook()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO 'public'<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    r_webhook RECORD;<br>BEGIN<br>    -- Busca webhooks ativos para o dispositivo ou globais ('sms_received' nos eventos)<br>    FOR r_webhook IN <br>        SELECT id, url, secret_key<br>        FROM public.user_webhooks<br>        WHERE is_active = true<br>          AND (device_id = NEW.device_id OR device_id IS NULL)<br>          AND ('sms_received' = ANY(events) OR events IS NULL)<br>    LOOP<br>        INSERT INTO public.webhook_delivery_queue (<br>            webhook_id,<br>            payload,<br>            attempts,<br>            max_attempts,<br>            status,<br>            next_retry_at<br>        ) VALUES (<br>            r_webhook.id,<br>            jsonb_build_object(<br>                'event', 'sms.received',<br>                'inbound_id', NEW.id,<br>                'device_id', NEW.device_id,<br>                'sim_slot', NEW.sim_slot,<br>                'from', NEW.sender_phone,<br>                'message', NEW.message,<br>                'received_at', NEW.received_at<br>            ),<br>            0,<br>            5,<br>            'PENDING',<br>            NOW()<br>        );<br>    END LOOP;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | get_dashboard_analytics            | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_dashboard_analytics(p_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)<br> RETURNS jsonb<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO 'public'<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    v_user_id uuid;<br>    v_target_year integer;<br>    v_current_month_start timestamptz;<br>    v_sent_month integer := 0;<br>    v_recv_month integer := 0;<br>    v_failed_month integer := 0;<br>    v_monthly_chart jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;<br>    v_chips_chart jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;<br>BEGIN<br>    v_user_id := auth.uid();<br>    v_target_year := COALESCE(p_year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::integer);<br>    v_current_month_start := date_trunc('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);<br><br>    /* 1. Métricas do Mês Atual (Soma fila ativa + histórico definitivo) */<br>    SELECT <br>        COALESCE(<br>            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.sms_queue <br>             WHERE status IN ('SENT', 'DELIVERED') AND created_at >= v_current_month_start<br>               AND (v_user_id IS NULL OR user_id = v_user_id))<br>            +<br>            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.sms_sent <br>             WHERE (sent_at >= v_current_month_start OR created_at >= v_current_month_start))<br>        , 0),<br>        COALESCE(<br>            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.sms_queue <br>             WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND created_at >= v_current_month_start<br>               AND (v_user_id IS NULL OR user_id = v_user_id))<br>            +<br>            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.sms_failed <br>             WHERE (failed_at >= v_current_month_start OR created_at >= v_current_month_start))<br>        , 0)<br>    INTO v_sent_month, v_failed_month;<br><br>    SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0)<br>    INTO v_recv_month<br>    FROM public.sms_inbound<br>    WHERE (<br>        v_user_id IS NULL <br>        OR device_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.devices WHERE user_id = v_user_id)<br>    )<br>    AND received_at >= v_current_month_start;<br><br>    /* 2. Gráfico Mensal: 12 meses do ano selecionado */<br>    WITH months AS (<br>        SELECT generate_series(<br>            make_timestamptz(v_target_year, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0),<br>            make_timestamptz(v_target_year, 12, 1, 0, 0, 0),<br>            interval '1 month'<br>        ) AS m_date<br>    ),<br>    all_sent AS (<br>        SELECT created_at AS dt FROM public.sms_queue WHERE status IN ('SENT', 'DELIVERED')<br>        UNION ALL<br>        SELECT COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) AS dt FROM public.sms_sent<br>    ),<br>    all_failed AS (<br>        SELECT created_at AS dt FROM public.sms_queue WHERE status = 'FAILED'<br>        UNION ALL<br>        SELECT COALESCE(failed_at, created_at) AS dt FROM public.sms_failed<br>    ),<br>    sent_stats AS (<br>        SELECT date_trunc('month', dt) AS m_date, COUNT(*) AS sent_total<br>        FROM all_sent<br>        WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt) = v_target_year<br>        GROUP BY 1<br>    ),<br>    failed_stats AS (<br>        SELECT date_trunc('month', dt) AS m_date, COUNT(*) AS failed_total<br>        FROM all_failed<br>        WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt) = v_target_year<br>        GROUP BY 1<br>    ),<br>    recv_stats AS (<br>        SELECT date_trunc('month', received_at) AS m_date, COUNT(*) AS recv_total<br>        FROM public.sms_inbound<br>        WHERE (v_user_id IS NULL OR device_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.devices WHERE user_id = v_user_id))<br>          AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM received_at) = v_target_year<br>        GROUP BY 1<br>    )<br>    SELECT COALESCE(<br>        jsonb_agg(<br>            jsonb_build_object(<br>                'month', to_char(m.m_date, 'Mon'),<br>                'month_num', EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m.m_date),<br>                'sent', COALESCE(s.sent_total, 0),<br>                'failed', COALESCE(f.failed_total, 0),<br>                'received', COALESCE(r.recv_total, 0)<br>            ) ORDER BY m.m_date<br>        ),<br>        '[]'::jsonb<br>    )<br>    INTO v_monthly_chart<br>    FROM months m<br>    LEFT JOIN sent_stats s ON s.m_date = m.m_date<br>    LEFT JOIN failed_stats f ON f.m_date = m.m_date<br>    LEFT JOIN recv_stats r ON r.m_date = m.m_date;<br><br>    /* 3. Desempenho por Chip/Slot no Ano */<br>    WITH slot_union AS (<br>        SELECT sim_slot, created_at AS dt FROM public.sms_queue WHERE status IN ('SENT', 'DELIVERED')<br>        UNION ALL<br>        SELECT sim_slot, COALESCE(sent_at, created_at) AS dt FROM public.sms_sent<br>    ),<br>    slot_counts AS (<br>        SELECT <br>            COALESCE(sim_slot, 0) AS slot_num,<br>            COUNT(*) AS total<br>        FROM slot_union<br>        WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt) = v_target_year<br>        GROUP BY COALESCE(sim_slot, 0)<br>    )<br>    SELECT COALESCE(<br>        jsonb_agg(<br>            jsonb_build_object(<br>                'sim_slot', slot_num,<br>                'total_sent', total<br>            )<br>        ),<br>        '[]'::jsonb<br>    )<br>    INTO v_chips_chart<br>    FROM slot_counts;<br><br>    RETURN jsonb_build_object(<br>        'current_month', json_build_object(<br>            'sent', v_sent_month,<br>            'received', v_recv_month,<br>            'failed', v_failed_month<br>        ),<br>        'year', v_target_year,<br>        'monthly_evolution', v_monthly_chart,<br>        'by_chip', v_chips_chart<br>    );<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | handle_new_tenant_user             | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_tenant_user()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>  INSERT INTO public.tenants (<br>    nome,<br>    email,<br>    plano,<br>    max_devices,<br>    max_monthly_sms,<br>    max_contacts,<br>    allow_scheduling,<br>    is_master<br>  )<br>  VALUES (<br>    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'name', split_part(NEW.email, '@', 1)),<br>    NEW.email,<br>    'FREE',<br>    1,<br>    300,<br>    100,<br>    false,<br>    false<br>  )<br>  ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;<br>  <br>  RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | is_master                          | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_master()<br> RETURNS boolean<br> LANGUAGE sql<br> STABLE SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO 'public'<br>AS $function$<br>  SELECT COALESCE(<br>    (SELECT is_master FROM public.tenants WHERE email = (SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()) LIMIT 1),<br>    false<br>  );<br>$function$<br> | public         | process_due_sms_schedules          | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_due_sms_schedules(batch_limit integer DEFAULT 150)<br> RETURNS integer<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO 'public'<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    r RECORD;<br>    v_count INT := 0;<br>BEGIN<br>    FOR r IN <br>        SELECT <br>            id, <br>            campaign_id, <br>            user_id, <br>            target_device_id, <br>            sim_slot, <br>            phone, <br>            message<br>        FROM public.sms_schedule<br>        WHERE status = 'WAITING'<br>          AND scheduled_for <= NOW()<br>        ORDER BY scheduled_for ASC<br>        LIMIT batch_limit<br>        FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED<br>    LOOP<br>        -- Insere na fila de envio imediato<br>        INSERT INTO public.sms_queue (<br>            campaign_id,<br>            user_id,<br>            target_device_id,<br>            sim_slot,<br>            phone,<br>            message,<br>            status,<br>            created_at,<br>            updated_at<br>        ) VALUES (<br>            r.campaign_id,<br>            r.user_id,<br>            r.target_device_id,<br>            COALESCE(r.sim_slot, 0),<br>            r.phone,<br>            r.message,<br>            'PENDING',<br>            NOW(),<br>            NOW()<br>        );<br><br>        -- Atualiza a schedule apenas após o insert concluído<br>        UPDATE public.sms_schedule<br>        SET status = 'PROCESSED',<br>            updated_at = NOW()<br>        WHERE id = r.id;<br><br>        v_count := v_count + 1;<br>    END LOOP;<br><br>    RETURN v_count;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | process_sms_opt_out                | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_sms_opt_out()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO 'public'<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    clean_sender TEXT;<br>    clean_msg TEXT;<br>BEGIN<br>    -- Converte para minúsculas e remove espaços das extremidades<br>    clean_msg := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.message, '')));<br><br>    -- Verifica se a mensagem começa com uma das palavras-chave (ex: "sair", "sair [COD: ...]", "cancelar")<br>    IF clean_msg ~* '^(sair\|stop\|cancelar\|parar\|descadastrar)(\\s\|$\|\\[)' THEN<br>        <br>        -- Limpa o número do remetente (remove +, espaços, parênteses e traços)<br>        clean_sender := regexp_replace(COALESCE(NEW.sender_phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g');<br><br>        -- Atualiza o contato correspondente na tabela contacts<br>        UPDATE public.contacts<br>        SET opted_out = TRUE,<br>            opted_out_at = NOW()<br>        WHERE <br>            -- Correspondência com o número completo higienizado<br>            regexp_replace(phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = clean_sender<br>            -- Ou correspondência pelos últimos 10 ou 11 dígitos (DDD + número)<br>            OR RIGHT(regexp_replace(phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 11) = RIGHT(clean_sender, 11)<br>            OR RIGHT(regexp_replace(phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = RIGHT(clean_sender, 10);<br>            <br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | process_sms_schedule_to_queue      | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_sms_schedule_to_queue()<br> RETURNS void<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO 'public'<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    -- 1. Promove itens vencidos ou no horário de sms_schedule para sms_queue<br>    -- preservando o campaign_id original<br>    WITH moved_rows AS (<br>        INSERT INTO public.sms_queue (<br>            campaign_id,<br>            user_id,<br>            target_device_id,<br>            sim_slot,<br>            phone,<br>            message,<br>            scheduled_for,<br>            status,<br>            created_at,<br>            updated_at<br>        )<br>        SELECT <br>            s.campaign_id,<br>            s.user_id,<br>            s.target_device_id,<br>            s.sim_slot,<br>            s.phone,<br>            s.message,<br>            s.scheduled_for,<br>            'PENDING',<br>            NOW(),<br>            NOW()<br>        FROM public.sms_schedule s<br>        WHERE s.status = 'WAITING'<br>          AND s.scheduled_for <= NOW()<br>        RETURNING id, campaign_id, phone, message<br>    )<br>    -- 2. Atualiza o status em sms_schedule para PROCESSED/SENT ou remove<br>    UPDATE public.sms_schedule s<br>    SET status = 'PROCESSED',<br>        updated_at = NOW()<br>    WHERE s.status = 'WAITING'<br>      AND s.scheduled_for <= NOW();<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | process_webhook_delivery_queue     | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_webhook_delivery_queue(batch_limit integer DEFAULT 20)<br> RETURNS void<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO 'public'<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    r RECORD;<br>    v_headers JSONB;<br>BEGIN<br>    FOR r IN<br>        SELECT <br>            q.id AS queue_id,<br>            q.payload,<br>            q.attempts,<br>            w.url,<br>            w.secret_key<br>        FROM public.webhook_delivery_queue q<br>        JOIN public.user_webhooks w ON w.id = q.webhook_id<br>        WHERE q.status = 'PENDING'<br>          AND q.next_retry_at <= NOW()<br>          AND w.is_active = true<br>        ORDER BY q.created_at ASC<br>        LIMIT batch_limit<br>        FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED<br>    LOOP<br>        -- Monta os headers HTTP com Bearer Token se a secret_key estiver presente<br>        v_headers := jsonb_build_object('Content-Type', 'application/json');<br>        IF r.secret_key IS NOT NULL AND trim(r.secret_key) <> '' THEN<br>            v_headers := v_headers \|\| jsonb_build_object('Authorization', 'Bearer ' \|\| trim(r.secret_key));<br>        END IF;<br><br>        -- Dispara requisição HTTP POST assíncrona<br>        PERFORM net.http_post(<br>            url := r.url,<br>            body := r.payload,<br>            headers := v_headers,<br>            timeout_milliseconds := 5000<br>        );<br><br>        -- Atualiza status da fila para enviado<br>        UPDATE public.webhook_delivery_queue<br>        SET status = 'SENT',<br>            attempts = attempts + 1<br>        WHERE id = r.queue_id;<br><br>    END LOOP;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | processar_resultado_sms_queue      | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.processar_resultado_sms_queue()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO 'public'<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    -- Caso 1: Sucesso (DELIVERED ou SENT)<br>    IF NEW.status IN ('DELIVERED', 'SENT') THEN<br>        INSERT INTO public.sms_sent (<br>            id,<br>            phone,<br>            message,<br>            sim_slot,<br>            target_device_id,<br>            status,<br>            created_at,<br>            sent_at<br>        ) VALUES (<br>            NEW.id,<br>            NEW.phone,<br>            NEW.message,<br>            NEW.sim_slot,<br>            NEW.target_device_id,<br>            NEW.status,<br>            NEW.created_at,<br>            now()<br>        )<br>        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE <br>        SET status = EXCLUDED.status,<br>            sent_at = now();<br><br>        DELETE FROM public.sms_queue WHERE id = NEW.id;<br><br>    -- Caso 2: Falha (FAILED)<br>    ELSIF NEW.status = 'FAILED' THEN<br>        INSERT INTO public.sms_failed (<br>            id,<br>            phone,<br>            message,<br>            sim_slot,<br>            target_device_id,<br>            status,<br>            created_at,<br>            failed_at<br>        ) VALUES (<br>            NEW.id,<br>            NEW.phone,<br>            NEW.message,<br>            NEW.sim_slot,<br>            NEW.target_device_id,<br>            'FAILED',<br>            NEW.created_at,<br>            now()<br>        )<br>        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE <br>        SET status = 'FAILED',<br>            failed_at = now();<br><br>        DELETE FROM public.sms_queue WHERE id = NEW.id;<br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | protect_tenant_is_master           | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_tenant_is_master()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>  IF NEW.is_master IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_master THEN<br>    IF NOT public.is_master() THEN<br>      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Apenas o Admin Master pode alterar privilégios de administrador.';<br>    END IF;<br>  END IF;<br>  RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | release_scheduled_sms              | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.release_scheduled_sms()<br> RETURNS void<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    UPDATE public.sms_queue<br>    SET status = 'PENDING',<br>        updated_at = now()<br>    WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED'<br>      AND scheduled_for <= now();<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | send_sms_from_n8n                  | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.send_sms_from_n8n(p_device_id text, p_phone text, p_message text, p_sim_slot integer DEFAULT 0)<br> RETURNS jsonb<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO 'public'<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    v_clean_phone TEXT;<br>    v_queue_id UUID;<br>BEGIN<br>    -- 1. Sanitização básica do número de telefone (apenas números)<br>    v_clean_phone := regexp_replace(COALESCE(p_phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g');<br><br>    -- 2. Validações de entrada<br>    IF v_clean_phone = '' THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Telefone de destino inválido ou vazio';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF TRIM(COALESCE(p_message, '')) = '' THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'A mensagem não pode ser vazia';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF p_sim_slot NOT IN (0, 1) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'O slot do chip deve ser 0 (SIM 1) ou 1 (SIM 2)';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF TRIM(COALESCE(p_device_id, '')) = '' THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'O device_id é obrigatório';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    -- 3. Inserção direta na fila sms_queue<br>    INSERT INTO public.sms_queue (<br>        phone,<br>        message,<br>        sim_slot,<br>        target_device_id,<br>        status,<br>        created_at,<br>        updated_at<br>    ) VALUES (<br>        v_clean_phone,<br>        p_message,<br>        p_sim_slot,<br>        p_device_id,<br>        'PENDING',<br>        NOW(),<br>        NOW()<br>    )<br>    RETURNING id INTO v_queue_id;<br><br>    -- 4. Retorno estruturado para o n8n<br>    RETURN jsonb_build_object(<br>        'success', true,<br>        'queue_id', v_queue_id,<br>        'phone', v_clean_phone,<br>        'target_device_id', p_device_id,<br>        'sim_slot', p_sim_slot,<br>        'status', 'PENDING'<br>    );<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | set_sms_queue_tenant               | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_sms_queue_tenant()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    v_tenant UUID;<br>BEGIN<br>    IF NEW.tenant_id IS NULL THEN<br>        -- Tenta achar o tenant pelo email do usuário logado ou pega o primeiro tenant ativo<br>        SELECT id INTO v_tenant FROM public.tenants WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1;<br>        NEW.tenant_id := v_tenant;<br>    END IF;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | sync_campaign_progress_on_sms_sent | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_campaign_progress_on_sms_sent()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    v_campaign_id UUID;<br>    v_total INT;<br>    v_done INT;<br>BEGIN<br>    v_campaign_id := NEW.campaign_id;<br><br>    IF v_campaign_id IS NOT NULL THEN<br>        SELECT <br>            COALESCE(c.total_contacts, 0),<br>            (<br>                SELECT count(*) <br>                FROM public.sms_queue q <br>                WHERE q.campaign_id = v_campaign_id <br>                  AND q.status IN ('SENT', 'DELIVERED', 'FAILED')<br>            ) + (<br>                SELECT count(*) <br>                FROM public.sms_sent s <br>                WHERE s.campaign_id = v_campaign_id<br>            )<br>        INTO v_total, v_done<br>        FROM public.campaigns c<br>        WHERE c.id = v_campaign_id;<br><br>        UPDATE public.campaigns<br>        SET <br>            sent_count = v_done,<br>            status = CASE <br>                WHEN v_total > 0 AND v_done >= v_total THEN 'COMPLETED'<br>                ELSE status <br>            END,<br>            updated_at = NOW()<br>        WHERE id = v_campaign_id;<br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | trg_link_campaign_on_dispatch      | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_link_campaign_on_dispatch()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    v_camp UUID;<br>BEGIN<br>    IF NEW.campaign_id IS NULL THEN<br>        SELECT campaign_id INTO v_camp<br>        FROM public.sms_queue<br>        WHERE phone = NEW.phone<br>        ORDER BY created_at DESC<br>        LIMIT 1;<br>        <br>        NEW.campaign_id := v_camp;<br>    END IF;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | trg_update_campaign_stats          | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_update_campaign_stats()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF NEW.campaign_id IS NOT NULL THEN<br>        IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'sms_sent' THEN<br>            UPDATE public.campaigns<br>            SET sent_count = COALESCE(sent_count, 0) + 1,<br>                updated_at = NOW()<br>            WHERE id = NEW.campaign_id;<br>        ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'sms_failed' THEN<br>            UPDATE public.campaigns<br>            SET failed_count = COALESCE(failed_count, 0) + 1,<br>                updated_at = NOW()<br>            WHERE id = NEW.campaign_id;<br>        END IF;<br><br>        -- Conclui a campanha automaticamente se atingir o total<br>        UPDATE public.campaigns<br>        SET status = 'COMPLETED'<br>        WHERE id = NEW.campaign_id<br>          AND total_contacts > 0<br>          AND (COALESCE(sent_count, 0) + COALESCE(failed_count, 0)) >= total_contacts;<br>    END IF;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | public         | validate_api_token                 | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_api_token(p_token text)<br> RETURNS uuid<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO 'public'<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    v_tenant_id uuid;<br>BEGIN<br>    SELECT tenant_id INTO v_tenant_id<br>    FROM public.api_tokens<br>    WHERE token = p_token AND is_active = true;<br><br>    IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN<br>        UPDATE public.api_tokens <br>        SET last_used_at = now() <br>        WHERE token = p_token;<br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN v_tenant_id;<br>END;<br>$function$<br> | realtime       | apply_rls                          | CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.apply_rls(wal jsonb, max_record_bytes integer DEFAULT (1024 * 1024))<br> RETURNS SETOF realtime.wal_rls<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>declare<br>    -- Regclass of the table e.g. public.notes<br>    entity_ regclass = (quote_ident(wal ->> 'schema') \|\| '.' \|\| quote_ident(wal ->> 'table'))::regclass;<br><br>    -- I, U, D, T: insert, update ...<br>    action realtime.action = (<br>        case wal ->> 'action'<br>            when 'I' then 'INSERT'<br>            when 'U' then 'UPDATE'<br>            when 'D' then 'DELETE'<br>            else 'ERROR'<br>        end<br>    );<br><br>    -- Is row level security enabled for the table<br>    is_rls_enabled bool = (once per role)<br>        columns =<br>            array_agg(<br>                (<br>                    c.name,<br>                    c.type_name,<br>                    c.type_oid,<br> unnest(old_columns) c;<br><br>        if action <> 'DELETE' and count(1) = 0 from unnest(columns) c where c.is_pkey then<br>            -- Fan out 400 error per distinct selected_columns for this
